svg.desc: Local official-cloud practice runs reconstructed from saved fuzz telemetry. Paths are launch-to-target coordinates. Local points use the published formula on local counters and are not STP scores.
svg.text: Official cloud · seeds 100–104 · 4× owned native runs · ownship telemetry · local points, not STP scores
